About this item

  • Everyday Sound with Deep Bass - Enjoy clear and balanced audio for daily use. These wireless earbuds deliver deep bass, crisp highs, and rich sound for music, calls, and entertainment.
  • Quad Mic ENC for Clear Calls - Stay heard anywhere with bluetooth earbuds featuring Quad Mic ENC that reduces background noise and ensures clear voice quality on every call.
  • Small & Lightweight Design - A clean, playful design that fits seamlessly into your everyday life. These earbuds are lightweight and comfortable for all-day use.
  • Next-Gen Bluetooth v6.0 - Experience fast pairing and stable connectivity with advanced Bluetooth. These earbuds wireless keep your connection smooth throughout the day.
  • Up to 40 Hours Playtime - Enjoy long listening with wireless earbuds offering up to 40 hours of playtime. Perfect for daily use without frequent charging.

From the brand

Greatness isn’t born in silence. It’s Made of Noise.

Previous page

  2. Designed to inspire.

    Noise is a design-led lifestyle technology brand built for a generation that wants it all; great design, smart features, and technology that works as hard as they do.

    We are proudly homegrown, shaped by the evolving desires of aspirational India. Every product is a subtle yet meaningful upgrade to your everyday focusing on uncompromising attention to quality and aesthetic.

  3. How we get our start?

    We started with a simple belief: great technology shouldn't be a luxury. Founded in 2014, Noise was born to make intelligent, well-designed tech accessible to everyone and not just the few. From day one, we've been building for the everyday explorer.

    What makes Noise audio different?

    We focus on real-life listening. Globally inspired, contextually designed for Indian lifestyles, with AI-powered personalisation built in.

    Who is Noise audio for?

    For those who want great sound without the complexity. For those who move, multitask, and live dynamically.

  4. Noise Audio

    Visit the Store

  5. Master Series

    Master Series by Noise, tuned with Sound by Bose—delivers immersive, balanced sound with exceptional clarity in a refined design.

  6. Airwave MAX - Headphones

    Noise Airwave Max Headphones delivers spatial audio, deep bass, all-day comfort, and long battery for a powerful listening experience.

    How are ratings calculated?
    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the headphones' sound quality impressive, with one mentioning the bass booster feature. The battery life, connectivity, and noise cancellation receive mixed feedback - while some praise the battery backup and quick connection, others report charging issues and poor Bluetooth performance. The fit is generally good, though some mention the case being too loose, and durability is a concern as the right earbud stops working after less than a year. The value for money receives mixed reviews, with some finding it worthy while others say it's not worth the price.

      I’ve been using the Noise Buds VS104 Truly Wireless Earbuds for the past few weeks, and honestly, they’ve exceeded my expectations — especially considering the price point! They offer some premium-level features that make them a great choice for everyday use.

      Amazon India

      🎧 Sound & Performance

      The audio quality is genuinely impressive for budget TWS earbuds. The 13mm drivers deliver rich, punchy bass and clear mids, making music sound fuller and enjoyable across genres — from Bollywood hits to podcasts and videos.

      Amazon India

      🔋 Battery Life That Lasts

      One of the biggest highlights is the long battery life — up to 45 hours of total playback with the charging case. This means you can go several days without having to recharge, which is perfect for commuting or travel.

      Amazon India

      📞 Great Call Quality

      With quad microphones and Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC), voice calls come through reliably clear even in busy places. People on the other end hear you well, whether you’re walking outside or in a crowded room.

      Noise

      ⚡ Fast Charging & Connectivity

      The Instacharge feature is fantastic — just 10 minutes of charging gives you around 200 minutes of playback. Bluetooth 5.2 ensures stable connection with minimal dropouts.

      Amazon India

      💪 Comfort & Durability

      They fit comfortably in the ears for long listening sessions — whether you’re working, gaming, or jogging. The IPX5 water resistance also gives peace of mind during workouts or unexpected splashes.

      Noise

      👍 Why I’d Recommend These

      ✔ Excellent battery life

      ✔ Crisp sound with solid bass

      ✔ Good call clarity with ENC

      ✔ Fast charging is super handy

      ✔ Comfortable fit and decent build quality

      Overall, for anyone looking for reliable, feature-packed truly wireless earbuds without spending much, the Noise Buds VS104 are a fantastic pick. Highly recommended! 🎧✨

    About this Item

    • Everyday Sound with Deep Bass - Enjoy clear and balanced audio for daily use. These wireless earbuds deliver deep bass, crisp highs, and rich sound for music, calls, and entertainment.
    • Quad Mic ENC for Clear Calls - Stay heard anywhere with bluetooth earbuds featuring Quad Mic ENC that reduces background noise and ensures clear voice quality on every call.
    • Small & Lightweight Design - A clean, playful design that fits seamlessly into your everyday life. These earbuds are lightweight and comfortable for all-day use.
    • Next-Gen Bluetooth v6.0 - Experience fast pairing and stable connectivity with advanced Bluetooth. These earbuds wireless keep your connection smooth throughout the day.
    • Up to 40 Hours Playtime - Enjoy long listening with wireless earbuds offering up to 40 hours of playtime. Perfect for daily use without frequent charging.

    Product description

    Buds Play are built for easy, everyday listening. Lightweight, compact, and comfortable, they’re designed to move with you through workdays, workouts, breaks, and everything in between. With up to 40 hours of playtime, your music, calls, and content stay on longer without constant charging. A 13mm driver delivers rich, balanced sound that feels full without trying too hard, while low latency up to 50ms keeps audio perfectly in sync for gaming, videos, and reels. Stay effortlessly connected with Next-gen BT v6.0 while Quad Mic ENC keeps your voice clear on calls by cutting through background noise, and IPX4 water resistance makes Buds Play ready for sweat, splashes, and real-life moments.
